programs.title: Photographer
programs.desc: Behind the scenes of the work of respected photographers.Paul Nicklen and Cristina Mittermeier, Anand Varma, Dan Winters, Campbell Addy, Krystle Wright and Muhammed Muheisen talk about their professional experiences.Each episode presents the life of one of the enthusiasts - from childhood and the beginning of his career to modern times and current challenges.Exciting stories are enriched by archival recordings, interviews and fragments of current projects.Viewers will learn the stories behind famous photos and the motivations of the people who decided to stand behind the camera.

programs.title: Top Guns: The Next Generation
programs.desc: Behind the scenes of the world of U.S. fighter pilotsNavy.Viewers will learn about preparations for the start of combat missions and exams.Sometimes dreams collide with reality and not everyone manages to survive the technically demanding training.The cameras were installed, among others,in the cockpit of the machines to see for yourself what bombing exercises look like.Candidates face impressive speeds and overloads.Sometimes physical limitations prove to be an insurmountable obstacle.In such conditions, it's easy to make a mistake, you really need to have nerves of steel.One of the key skills is precise landing on an aircraft carrier.Cadets also practice direct combat.To complete this stage, you need to defeat your own mentor and score a "hit" while avoiding the crosshair yourself.On the ground, there will be briefings conducted by demanding instructors.There are many difficult moments when you doubt and lose faith in your own abilities.At the end there is a week of truth.The daredevils then have one last chance to earn the prestigious badge.

programs.title: Trafficked with Mariana Van Zeller
programs.desc: Correspondent Mariana van Zeller has been following the trail of smugglers for over fifteen years.During his dangerous work, he meets not only criminals, but also representatives of the justice system, former prisoners and members of local communities.The journalist paints a shocking picture of the gray zone where billions of dollars are traded.The reporter will learn about the activities of counterfeiters, drug dealers, and the illegal sale of weapons, fentanyl and animals.Among her interlocutors was Joe Exotic, the former owner of the controversial zoo.In 2019, he was sentenced to 22 years in prison.
